ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read from the text of the problem the three boundary straight lines: 2x-y-2=0, namely y=2x-2; x+2y-1=0, namely y=(1-x)/2; 3x+y-8=0, namely y=8-3x. According to the directions of the inequality signs, the feasible region satisfies y≤2x-2, y≥(1-x)/2, y≤8-3x, and is the intersection of the three half-planes. Find the boundary intersection points: y=2x-2 and y=(1-x)/2 intersect, giving x=1, y=0, namely (1,0); y=2x-2 and y=8-3x intersect, giving x=2, y=2, namely (2,2); y=(1-x)/2 and y=8-3x intersect, giving x=3, y=-1, namely (3,-1). Therefore the feasible region is the triangular region with vertices (1,0), (2,2), (3,-1), and within the region x is all positive. The slope of the straight line OM is k=y/x. Since x>0, examine this linear fractional function on the closed triangular region; its maximum and minimum values can be attained at vertices or boundary endpoints. Calculate the slopes of the three vertices: (1,0) corresponds to k=0; (2,2) corresponds to k=1; (3,-1) corresponds to k=-1/3. So the minimum value is -1/3.

method.method_draft: 把斜率 k 看作过原点的直线 y=kx 的参数，寻找这条直线与可行区域有交点时 k 的最小值。由不等式组改写为 y≤2x-2、y≥(1-x)/2、y≤8-3x。可行区域的最低负斜率方向会出现在过原点的直线刚好支撑区域的边界点处。重点检查下边界 y=(1-x)/2，因为它给出负斜率可能；在该边界上与上边界 y=8-3x 相交得到端点 (3,-1)。过原点与该点的斜率为 -1/3。再确认其他边界点的斜率不更小：边 y=(1-x)/2 上 k=(1-x)/(2x) 随 x 增大而减小，最大 x 为 3；因此最小就是 -1/3。
